verdict.rationale: Paychex Flex's own marketing describes built-in AI-powered compliance support that answers questions and generates HR documents. It also describes AI-suggested modifications for missing time punches. Together these show an in-product AI that takes on some delegated tasks, but the scope is narrow and the evidence is thin. Missing for 10: a named general-purpose in-product assistant, evidence it can carry out actions such as running payroll or updating records when asked, documentation of its capabilities and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Get AI-powered compliance support to answer your questions, generate HR documents, monitor regulatory changes
AI-suggested Modifications and employee self-service speed up fixes for missing punches.
